columns.name: EPJP_JOURNEY_STATUS
columns.description: PJP Journey Status. Possible Values : S = Started, E = Ended Purpose: When the DSR starts his journey, he will mark his PJP as "Started" and when he completed his journey he will mark his PJP as "Ended". This flag will be used at the time of Day End Process. If this flag has not marked as "Ended" or if it is Not Found then the system would not execute the Day End Process successfully. Based on this flag (Ended), the Day End process will generate his Journey Plan automatically for the next day.
